Only /shop/ has real pagination (lastPage=693, perPage=24 = 16,632 ~ x-wp-total 16,615). stageNotes: Stage 1: apex gotenda.com 307-redirects to https://www.gotenda.com/ inside Playwright; www is canonical.

Stage 2: Sucuri active JS-cookie challenge on every direct curl (8/8 batches return 307). Playwright solves once; cookies cached 30min via existing waf-cookie-manager flow. recaptcha-v3 script present site-wide but does NOT gate the catalog crawl path - hasCaptcha=false (operational rule). No age-gate.
Stage 3: WooCommerce confirmed - WordPress 6.7.1 generator meta + /wp-json/wc/store/v1 returns JSON. Both Store API and WP REST core agree on count.

Stage 4: catalogUrl coverage RE-TESTED in R2. Every /product-category/ slug tested (DB list + R1 live-taxonomy list) returned lastPage=1 - they are curated WP landing pages, NOT walkable category indexes. The only walkable catalog is /shop/ (lastPage=693, perPage=24 = 16,632 ~ expected 16,615). DB slugs /firearms/, /ammunition/, /knives/ return HTTP 404. DB slug /optic/ returns 200 with canonical redirect to /product-category/gun-deals-promotions-canada/may-specials/optic/ (a promo sub-sub-category, not the firearm-optics top-level). Catalog URL collapsed to single /shop/.

Stage 5: zero-overlap test passed for BOTH ?paged=2 and /page/2/ - they return identical 24-slug sets with zero overlap to page 1. DB notes claim ?page=N is silently ignored - that is the WP single-post-pagination `?page=` collision, NOT the WC archive `?paged=` query var. Either form is valid; chose path-style /page/{N} per DB precedent (theme-override-safe).
Stage 6: 3-outcome sort test. Default == ?orderby=date == newest. Sort honored. Adopted DB explicit &order=desc for theme-override safety.
Stage 7: WC WP REST modified_after two-probe passed. api-date-since-watermark.

Stage 8: wp-rest-header via /wp-json/wc/store/v1/products?per_page=1 -> x-wp-total=16615. Cross-confirmed vs WP REST core 16615 and sitemap-index sum 16616. Skill priority: wp-rest-header (1 req) > sitemap-index (17 reqs, brittle to merchant adding/removing sitemap files).

Stage 9: perPage RE-TESTED. /shop/?per_page=100 returns same 24 li.product cards as /shop/?per_page=24 - WC's HTML catalog ignores per_page query param. perPage=24 is the runtime-correct value for HTML pagination (paginationPattern.perPage). DB's 100 was the API perPage (woocommerce.ts:293 caps API requests at min(opts.perPage ?? 100, 100)); for HTML walking 24 is correct.
r2DivergencesResolved: expectedProductCount: R1 wins (16615 live vs DB 16440 stale 6 weeks).
productCountMethod: R1 wins (wp-rest-header 1 req vs DB sitemap-index 17 reqs; both agree on count).
perPage: R1 wins (HTML pagination is fixed at 24; ?per_page=100 ignored - verified by GET /shop/?per_page=100 returning 24 li.product).
catalogUrls: R1 wins (DB has 3x 404 slugs + 4x lastPage=1 landing pages; ONLY /shop/ is a walkable catalog with lastPage=693).
paginationPattern: inconclusive - both ?paged=2 (query/paged) and /page/2/ (path/page) return identical 24-slug sets. Chose DB path-style for theme-override safety.
sortParam: DB wins (explicit &order=desc safer; functionally equivalent).
hasCaptcha: R1 wins (recaptcha-v3 script-tag presence != operational gating; catalog path is reachable without solving).
wafWorkaround: DB wins (operator residue but production-needed cookie-cache flow; restored from DB).
searchUrl: DB wins (skill gap; uncontroversial WP default; restored from DB).
